```yaml
name: Lint ObjC `new` Usage

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-new-usage:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find ObjC `new` usage
        id: find_new
        run: |
          echo "Searching for [ClassName new] patterns in .m and .h files..."
          # Find all .m and .h files and grep for the pattern
          matches=$(find . -type f \( -name '*.m' -o -name '*.h' \) -print0 | \
            xargs -0 grep -nE '\[[A-Za-z0-9_]+\s+new\]' 2>/dev/null)
          if [ -n "$matches" ]; then
            echo "❌ Found [ClassName new] usage:"
            echo "$matches"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ No [ClassName new] usage found."
          fi
```
